No first-party ordering page exists for the Rancho Bernardo branch. Found via WebSearch: a DoorDash marketplace store page whose JSON-LD address (11611 Rancho Bernardo Road) matches our work-list address exactly. 91 raw items; the 'Most Ordered' carousel (12 items) is dropped as duplicate of categorized sections except 'Fresh Baked Cookies', which appears nowhere else and is kept under Sides. Cent distribution over 91 prices: .00 x20, .25 x8, .26 x1 (single outlier, Iced Strawberry Matcha), .50 x25, .75 x13, .99 x24 - overwhelmingly conventional cafe pricing (.00/.25/.50/.75/.99), no divisor-4 or POS-fee pattern found; divisor sweep at 1.04-1.30 produced no clean landing. About half the items (drink/sandwich sizes) carry a '+' in the DoorDash payload, meaning the figure is the cheapest size/base option; flagged per-item in the section field rather than silently dropped.

notes: The listed domain fruteriadisfrutalas.com no longer serves the restaurant - it 200s with an ad-block-detection / forced-click redirector script (ad-overlay/prebid-wrapper JS, auto .click() on a hidden element), a hijacked-domain pattern; left without interacting further, per policy. A second candidate first-party domain (orderfruteriadisfrutalas.com) fails DNS entirely. Both DoorDash and Uber Eats storefronts at the exact work-list address (3647 University Ave) were checked. DoorDash (59 items) was rejected: many prices divide cleanly by 1.15 onto whole dollars ($13.80->$12.00, $16.10->$14.00, $8.05->$7.00, $34.50->$30.00, $5.75->$5.00) - a baked-in markup - and even the divided values do not match Uber Eats' prices for the same items (e.g. DD Breakfast Bagel $13.80/1.15=$12.00 vs UE Breakfast Bagel $10.00), so the two are not simply the same base with different fees and cannot be reconciled; DoorDash dropped entirely, not divided out. Uber Eats' 67 items have a cent distribution of .00 x10, .25 x18, .50 x3, .75 x35, .90 x1 - 98.5% land on conventional quarter-dollar endings, and no divisor (1.04-1.30) produces a majority landing on round/.95/.99 values - read as the real wall price. crossCheckedAgainst names DoorDash only to document the comparison that ruled it out, not as corroboration. Three actual rows: "Fruit Salad, Choice of cottage cheese or yogurt. Granola, raisins... $11.25", "Grilled Chicken Bagel, Avocado, lettuce, onions... $10.75", "Bionico, [no description] $10.00".

The 8th disagreed in both name and price - PDF says "French fries $9", brunchspotter says "fried rice $5" - the PDF's own French Fries $9 was kept (fried rice is already a separate $16 entree elsewhere, so the two sources are plainly not describing the same simple side). Wine and beer prices are from the first-party drinks PDF directly (plain text there, names/prices in matching sequential order under both -layout and -raw extraction). Coffee/mimosa items are from brunchspotter (Specialties list only; a generic "Coffee $4-$6" range and two unlabeled "Non-Alcoholic $X-$Y" ranges were dropped as not naming individual items). All prices are whole dollars (or clean glass|bottle pairs) - plausible trendy-brunch pricing for 2026, no markup pattern. Restaurant's own site advertises Brunch Menu and Drink Menu only (hours: Brunch daily 8/9am-3pm) - no separate dinner menu was found or listed, so brunch+drinks is treated as the complete menu.
